intent: Technical Brief: System State Baseline for Asus ROG Zephyrus G14
detected_fault: Distorted screen display when iGPU is disabled
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Verify that the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 driver is up-to-date.
Run a stress test on the system to identify any potential thermal or hardware issues.
Consider performing a clean installation of the operating system and drivers.
